description: VIDEO-LIMIT-001 stage A (owner 2026-11-19 «1 да»: build the official Telegram Bot API server on the host; bot and site untouched). Bounded, resumable run in the existing private inbox: upload this package, run source_remote.py once in a temporary always-on task (removed after its receipt; never the CRM bot) which, inside the inbox folder videobuild_work only, builds gperf 3.1 (GNU tarball, sha256 checked) and tdlib/telegram-bot-api at a pinned commit with cmake, one thread, lowest priority, at most 40 minutes per run (the next run continues), and reports progress, disk use and the built program version. No application source, CRM, HTML, media, bot state or Telegram change; nothing outside the inbox is written.
title: Video server build
